The file has already been created successfully — 677 lines, full Snake game with all three modes, CPU AI, keyboard controls, score display, start menu, game over screen, and restart via Space.

Here's what's in `snake_openrouter-upstage-solar-pro4_01.html`:

**Game modes** (selectable from start menu):
- **Human vs Human** — P1 uses WASD, P2 uses Arrow keys
- **CPU vs Human** — CPU controls P2 (red), you control P1 (green) with WASD
- **CPU vs CPU** — both snakes are AI-controlled

**Features:**
- 30×30 grid on a 600×600 canvas
- Continuous movement at 150ms tick rate
- Food spawning (orange circles with glow), snake grows on eat
- Wall + self + other-snake collision = death
- Real-time scoreboard for both players
- CPU uses BFS pathfinding to hunt nearest food, with fallback to center-seeking when no path exists
- Start menu with mode buttons (also keyboard-navigable with arrows + Enter/Space)
- Game over screen showing winner and final scores
- Press **Space** or click **Play Again** to return to menu and restart
- **P** to pause/resume during gameplay

Open the file in any browser to play.
